messages.text: Good speaking today. Could you put together a short proposal covering scope and pricing so I can take it to my head of ops?
Will do - I'll have a draft proposal with you by friday.
Hold off on that actually. Our budget cycle just got pushed, so we're parking all new vendor work until the next quarter. I'll come back to you in July.
Understood - I'll leave it with you. Happy to pick it up whenever.

loops.statement: send Aditya a draft proposal covering scope and pricing
loops.notes: Aditya's 'I'll come back to you in July' is not labelled as a new loop: it is a vague future intention with no agreed obligation and no date the user could hold him to. See the pleasantry rule.
